info.title: Niu Platform & Provider Administration API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/docs/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/docs/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session,
platform authority, explicit delegated workspace capability or Provider membership stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` path segments refer to workspaces; legacy `provider` paths refer to Providers.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units; Provider purchase rates and customer charges are separate.

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

200.description: Quote version summaries and optional next_after cursor.

get.summary: Read an immutable Provider quote version
get.description: Platform administration required. Returns original source evidence without fetching or repricing. A version from another Provider is unavailable. Historical versions remain readable after a later adapter change.

200.description: Original quote evidence and source identity.

post.summary: Estimate supplied billable quantities against an immutable quote
post.description: Platform administration required. Read-only calculation: no inference or billing mutation. model is the upstream ID, revision is a captured quote version, quantities are disjoint billable meters (uncached input must exclude cached tokens). Exact decimal arithmetic; unsupported/unknown/overflowing meters remain explicit and never imply zero. Conditional quotes require an explicit matching condition from the captured evidence; no time or holiday calendar is guessed. Separate currency totals and partial coverage are retained. This is not an actual Provider invoice or a Niu customer charge.

200.description: Quote-bound estimate with currency totals and unknown coverage.

get.summary: Read Provider-adapter advertised price evidence
get.description: Platform administration required. Uses explicit saved Provider service identity and a bounded official/public source read without forwarding credentials. No tariffs, balances or model routes are changed. Partial native ratios are not money; empty/unqualified feeds are unknown, not free. Source and observation time are returned. Qualified official-page adapters validate their observed schema and preserve conditional or unsupported rates; changed schemas remain unavailable.

200.description: Unified advertised pricing evidence with completeness limits.

502.description: Source failure; retry the read without mutating configuration.

post.summary: Capture an immutable Provider quote version
post.description: Platform administration required. Performs bounded price discovery and appends source evidence only if saved Provider adapter identity/revision still matches. Unknown/partial sources remain explicit. Does not change any customer tariff, route, balance or charge. Never blindly replay after uncertainty; retain the returned revision for historical estimates.

200.description: Immutable quote revision, capture time, adapter binding and evidence.

409.description: Adapter identity changed; no snapshot saved.

post.summary: Discover and import Provider models
post.description: Platform administration required. Reads the bounded upstream catalog, then atomically creates missing model mappings. Owner-funded mappings are enabled; shared commercial mappings start disabled and unpriced. Existing mappings, disabled choices, prices and grants are preserved. No inference or payment is performed. Catalog access is not inference verification or selling eligibility. Credential revision conflicts abort the import; retry is safe and adds only missing upstream IDs.

200.description: Import counts and discovery evidence.

409.description: Connection changed or an alias conflicts; no models imported.

502.description: Upstream catalog read failed; saved connection is retained.

post.summary: Restore original consumed Credits ranges
post.description: Platform administration required. Restores the next unrefunded prefix of an original resolved charge. Original source, definition and expiry remain unchanged; expired restored units stay expired. Purchase conversion and current tariffs are never used. Identical idempotent replay returns the original immutable receipt; conflicting replay and cumulative over-refund are rejected. Concurrent refunds serialize on the unit account. This does not execute an external payment refund, reverse a purchase, or release an unresolved inference hold. No monetary backing or procurement information is returned. Quantities are exact decimal strings.

200.description: Original immutable refund receipt

404.description: No Credits reservation in the specified organization

409.description: Unresolved or released charge, over-refund or conflicting retry

get.summary: Preview a Credits purchase reversal and read committed reversal receipts
get.description: Platform administration required. Evaluates the unoccupied (unconsumed, unreserved and unreversed) ranges of an original Credits purchase lot and computes the exact processor-representable refund amount (whole minor units of 10000000 nanounits), the reversible atom prefix and any residual atoms or monetary backing that cannot be represented at processor precision without discarding value. Also returns all previously committed reversal receipts on the order. Consumed ranges require an explicit charge refund before they become reversible. Does not mutate state or execute an external payment refund.

parameters.name: credit_atoms
parameters.description: Optional target unoccupied atom prefix to evaluate; defaults to all currently available unoccupied atoms on the purchase lot.

200.description: Purchase reversal preview and committed reversal history

404.description: No settled Credits purchase lot for the specified organization and order

409.description: Requested atoms exceed currently available unoccupied purchase capacity

post.summary: Reverse unoccupied Credits purchase ranges at processor minor-unit precision
post.description: Platform administration required. Records an immutable reversal of unoccupied ranges belonging to an original Credits purchase lot. The requested atom quantity must map to a positive whole minor-unit payment refund (divisible by 10000000 nanounits) with zero discarded residual atoms or backing. Simulated purchases preserve zero cash backing and never enter verified cash funding reversals. Identical idempotent replay returns the original receipt even after later charges, reversals or rule changes; conflicting reuse returns 409. Recording a reversal does not execute an external payment-processor transfer.

200.description: Immutable purchase reversal receipt

400.description: Invalid atom quantity, inexact processor minor-unit refund, residual atoms or invalid reason

404.description: No settled Credits purchase lot for the specified organization and order

409.description: Requested atoms exceed unoccupied capacity or idempotency key reused with different input

post.summary: Publish a versioned Credits text consumption tariff
post.description: Platform administration required and rechecked transactionally for operators. Publish atom-denominated rates independently of purchase conversion and monetary tariffs. New publication requires the current unit definition and installation revision. Concurrent stale writes conflict. Equal idempotent retries return their original normalized publication, even after later price or unit changes; changed input conflicts. Rates and quantity thresholds use exact decimal strings; context thresholds are unique and normalized in ascending order. Nullable category rates use ordinary rates, never inherit another tier. Rates are per million tokens, rounded upward once after adding applicable exact token products. Add the fixed request fee, then apply the minimum charge. Explicit zero is valid; absence of a publication is unavailable. Publishing a tariff does not activate billing mode, issue Credits, convert money balances, admit requests or change prior request bindings.

post.summary: Issue noncash Credits with an immutable provenance and expiry
post.description: Platform administration required. New issuance requires active Credits mode and the current unit definition. Promotional and simulated grants have zero monetary backing and create neither a payment receipt nor a monetary balance entry. Provide a customer-appropriate reason. Expiry is optional and must be in the future when new issuance commits. Reusing an idempotency key with the same semantic input returns the original grant without extending expiry, even after expiry or later unit publications. Different input conflicts. The returned amount is original issuance, not current spendable capacity. Purchased provenance is reserved for independently verified payments. Operator authority is rechecked under a transaction lock.

post.summary: Save a billing-mode change preview
post.description: Platform administration required. Saves an immutable fifteen-minute compatibility snapshot without changing mode, balances or prices. Requires the current installation revision. A blocked or same-mode snapshot may be saved for review but cannot authorize publication. Identical idempotent replay returns the original snapshot and expiry even after later configuration changes; conflicting reuse is rejected. The actual mode publication must recheck current financial state. Quantities and revisions are exact strings.

put.summary: Publish a preview-confirmed installation billing mode
put.description: Platform administration required and rechecked under lock. Requires an unexpired originally compatible saved preview, its matching current revision and a distinct target mode. Rechecks customer obligations atomically while holding financial-table locks. Concurrent financial activity returns a retryable 409; re-read compatibility if state changed. Balances, prices, monetary limits and historical records are never converted. A successful publication creates an immutable change receipt and advances the installation revision once. Identical idempotent retry returns the original receipt even after subsequent mode changes; it does not reapply the old mode. Mode activation alone does not establish configured unit prices, compatible spending limits, model availability or media readiness. Existing monetary limits require explicit compatible configuration before affected Credits admission. New monetary grants/funding require currency mode and new unit issuance requires Credits mode.

200.description: Original durable result

get.summary: Preview installation billing-mode incompatibilities
get.description: Platform administration required. One current database statement reports incompatible customer balances, credit facilities, pending checkouts, unposted charges, unresolved customer requests and reservations, unapplied monetary grant intents and remaining unexpired Credits. Enabling Credits additionally requires a unit definition and matching platform-currency purchase rule. Each category includes complete counts and at most 100 affected company accounts, with explicit truncation. Original tariffs and monetary limits are retained and summarized, never converted. Existing monetary limits still require explicit compatible Credits configuration before those workspaces or keys can spend Credits. This is advisory only: blockers_empty does not activate billing mode, prove route readiness or authorize a later switch. Any mode publication must revalidate current state atomically. Reads never modify accounts or history. Same-mode previews still report current incompatibilities. No procurement amounts or credentials are included. Internal account identifiers are routing references, not display labels.

200.description: Current advisory compatibility snapshot

post.summary: Supplement missing native request usage from captured OpenRouter evidence
post.description: Installation write access only. Empty object input; no client-supplied generation identifier, quantities or costs. Uses the stored server response reference and original managed credential only while its vendor revision remains current and enabled. New captured references pin the dispatched upstream model independently of later mapping edits; legacy references without that binding still require the unchanged enabled model revision. supports_messages_tools.description: Explicit buffered native client-tool capability; requires supports_messages. Streaming tools require the separate supports_messages_streaming_tools capability.

supports_messages_streaming.description: Explicit native text SSE opt-in; requires supports_messages.

supports_messages.description: Explicit native Messages nonstreaming text capability for OpenRouter or Anthropic routes. Does not imply streaming, tools or media support.

VideoSchema.description: Versioned constraints for the exact alias/upstream model/channel. The enclosing capabilities document is limited to 16 KiB. Backend validation enforces relative bounds, defaults, input transport, roles and incompatible controls. Configuration does not qualify a route or enable unsupported media/callback transport.

revision.description: Trimmed canonical revision with no control characters; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

model_alias.description: Must match the enclosing model alias.

upstream_model.description: Must match the enclosing upstream mapping.

channel.description: Exact canonical channel contract; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

required_controls.description: Every named control must be configured.

exclusive_controls.description: Each pair names distinct configured controls; both cannot have defaults.

callbacks_qualified.description: Required for a callback_url declaration; separate adapter/offer qualification and callback authentication still apply.

VideoOutputSchema.description: Optional effective output mapping for this schema revision. Requires resolution, ratio and positive duration controls, each with a default or required input. Pixel estimation requires a positive frame-rate control or an observed output frame rate. With allow_unmapped_output enabled, owner-funded generation accepts other supported combinations without an estimate. Customer-funded generation still requires a mapped pair. Estimates never establish reported usage or maximum liability. The ark-direct-v1 adapter qualifies video_tokens only; openrouter-video-v1 supports owner-funded text generation with seconds estimates and unknown reported quantity.

observed_frames_per_second.description: Observed output FPS for pixel estimates when no request FPS control exists. Never sent upstream.

allow_unmapped_output.description: Allow owner-funded generation for otherwise supported combinations without an effective output estimate.

estimator_revision.description: Reviewed configuration reference; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

resolution.description: Must be accepted by the configured resolution control.

ratio.description: Must be accepted by the configured ratio control; each resolution/ratio pair is unique.

VideoInputRule.description: Item/count bounds cannot exceed the enclosing request limits. Non-text inputs require HTTPS or at least one allowed Base64 MIME type; required roles need at least one allowed role. Names are trimmed, control-free and limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

VideoIntegerControl.description: Signed 64-bit integer bounds; maximum must be at least minimum and any default must lie within them. The dashboard edits exact JavaScript-safe integers only.

VideoChoiceControl.description: Values are canonical names of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; any default must be one of them.

pricing.description: Optional validated route pricing. Personal-owned credentials require null pricing; non-null pricing is rejected at save. Null clears pricing; omission preserves existing pricing on updates and leaves cost unknown on creates.

available.description: Configuration eligibility in the management list; not an upstream health or entitlement check.

owner_funded.description: Management-list metadata identifying owner-funded routes. Omitted from configuration writes.

issue_session.description: False requires Idempotency-Key and forbids expires_in_seconds.
